storyInfo: Sonya rallies the arguing students to rescue those deceived by the thugs. She learns that most of the students were tricked by the thug leader Gromov into a human auction on the way. After weathering a series of brutal clashes and misunderstandings, Sonya makes up her mind to take Gromov down.

attributes.content: Say that again!
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: The Vanguards will not be retrieving Leonid's corpse. Did you get it this time?
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: His corpse? He's warming himself up by the fireplace right now, laughing at idiots like you!
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: You just want to wait here your whole life, fighting over scraps of food and firewood!
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: I knew you Vanguards were useless imbeciles the moment you started yelling about rescuing Lavrya by force!
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: Go ahead then, go kneel before those thugs. I want to see if you really can get out, or if you'll be sent back like Shorty.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: We're off—
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: Hold it!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Where are you going? You think those assholes will listen to you?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You guys really are still stuck in the same rut, huh...
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Rosalind? What are you doing here?
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: I came to help Sonya, and to stop you dumbasses from throwing your lives away while I'm at it!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Hmph. Why worry about what they're doing...?
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Yesterday, when that guy named Fedya carried Shorty's body back, they were still making snide remarks.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: ...Listen, it is dangerous out there. Those thugs will not let you walk away, no matter how much you pay them.
attributes.name: Melancholy Youth

attributes.content: You think it's true just because you said so? Who the hell do you think you are? You saw Shorty bribe them with your own eyes, did you?
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: I—
attributes.name: Melancholy Youth

attributes.content: His pockets were so clean, not even lice would live in them. How could he ever come up with the idea of bribing someone? He must have been killed when trying to break out.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: That's just a guess, but those guys who call themselves the 'Council of Sixteen' aren't the kind of people you can bargain with.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya... When you were away, someone sent us a letter. It's from Naum, from the Symposium.
attributes.name: Worried Student

attributes.content: He writes: 'The leader of the Council of Sixteen, Gromov, is a reasonable man. So long as you have enough money, we can walk free.'
attributes.name: Worried Student

attributes.content: Where's the letter?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Here.
attributes.name: Worried Student

attributes.content: Is that all? Are we done? Just let us leave this damned place already.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: Wait.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You've got no grounds to stop us, Sonya! Not even you!
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: Out of our way!
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: He rashly pushes his way through the crowd, reaching out to grab hold of Zima's sleeve.
Blam! A loud slap slams into his face.
It is almost as if the slap has pushed some button, when everyone grinds to a halt.
Wake up already! Don't you understand what this letter means?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You Symposium people are writing day in, day out. Would any of you have handwriting this sloppy? It's practically going off the page. The best possible outcome here is that he's trading your lives for a meal.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: That's not true—
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: You seriously haven't figured it out? Or do you like keeping your head stuck in the sand? Still stubbornly believing in a way out of here that doesn't involve fighting back?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Then... What should we do?
attributes.name: Worried Student

attributes.content: Save lives.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: This letter and Shorty should be enough proof that the Council of Sixteen is dangerous. We can't just sit by and watch as Leonid drags a bunch of people to their deaths.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: If only one of them still lives, I'll bring them back. If they're all still alive, I'll bring them all back.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Do you have a death wish too, Sonya?
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: If they got caught, that's just proof they were stupid and weak. They deserve to die—
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Shut up, Faddey.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I'm sick of you always insulting the other students. We need unity, if we want to keep everyone alive.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Unity? Hah! This empire was built by throwing weaklings like these Symposians into the river, one by one!
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: So, when Ursus finally got thrown into the river, you got pulled along with it, huh?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: There's no Vanguard or Symposium here. No nobles or commoners.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: There's only one thing we are in the eyes of that 'Council of Sixteen': fresh meat ready for butchering.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Yesterday, they killed Shorty. Tomorrow, they'll squish each and every one of our heads like helpless bugs. And right now, we're bickering our asses off. They don't need to split us up, we're doing it for them.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Even so, those slowing us down—
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: What about you, Faddey?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: When have you ever contributed a damn thing? Or is your 'greatness' just an empty shell, only able to be filled by watching the weak fall apart?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Keep your stupid superiority complex, it'll keep you company while you wait to turn into a corpse!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: As for everyone else... If you don't feel like dying a miserable death in a place like this, grab something you can crack a few skulls with.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I'm not asking you all to like the Symposium or anyone else, not even for a second... but right now, you gotta keep up with me if you want everyone to live!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The air seems to have frozen as she finishes her speech. Nobody dares to break the silence.
Until Leto spots a hand. A student cautiously raises his hand, the hesitance still clear on his face. But he is the first of his peers to answer her.
'Pencil Stub'! 'Pencil Stub', right? Whaddya feel like saying?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I... support Sonya's idea.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Those who left are our peers, our friends. We can't abandon them.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: But if possible, call me by my real name. I'm—
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: I support her too! Whether they're dead or alive, I just want to see how they really are!
attributes.name: Excited Student

attributes.content: I'm with her—
attributes.name: Everyone

attributes.content: Several students stand up, then more, and even more. They gather by Sonya's side.
Good. Ten or so of you should be enough to make a scouting party.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I know a lot of you are still skeptical, but don't worry. I'll bring an answer back to you.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: ...Count me in.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Are you thinking of—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Don't overthink it. I just want to prove I'm right, so I can slap those Symposium cowards in the face.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: So, what do we do? Just give us the order, Sonya.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: First, we need to find a route we can use to flank the Council of Sixteen—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Err, Antosha told me to send you guys some supplies.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Have I come at a bad time?
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Perfect timing, actually. I was just thinking of going to your camp to get a guide, Matvey.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: If a fight breaks out, I'll make sure you're safe.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Don't underestimate me, Sonya.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Antosha wants to kill Gromov, but we were never able to find his lair.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: But luckily, our attempts to scout it out have led us to several of the thugs' active bases. We've got their details down—
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Trouble up ahead, Sonya!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Suka! They're getting closer!
attributes.name: Anxious Noble Student

attributes.content: What do we do, Nika? You always have ideas.
attributes.name: Anxious Noble Student

attributes.content: Don't panic, Yeremey, in just a moment—
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: The door bolt won't hold much longer!
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: What about the window, Nika? If we can't hold here, can we—
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: No go. There's two of them outside the window, and they've got steel pipes.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Come here and help me brace against this table. It's our last line of defense.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Her voice wavers as she thrusts a shiny kitchen knife into her friend's hands, pressing both hands down on the table corner like her life depends on it.
Yeremey takes a deep breath, pushing against the table's edge with his entire body. Though his forehead is covered in cold sweat, his face does not show a hint of cowardice.
Hey there, honored 'guests'.
attributes.name: Thug at the Door A

attributes.content: Don't bother trying to resist. We just wanna talk 'business'.
attributes.name: Thug at the Door A

attributes.content: Yeah, it's below twenty out here. Let us in already, we're freezing. Is this how kids these days treat visitors?
attributes.name: Thug at the Door B

attributes.content: If you don't open up, our 'service charge' is gonna go up to... say, an arm.
attributes.name: Thug at the Door A

attributes.content: Get lost!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: There's a ton of Originium-tipped bolts in this room pointed right at the door! Come any closer and you die!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Pfft. Originium-tipped bolts? You hear that, Pacient? She's got Originium-tipped bolts!
attributes.name: Thug at the Door A

attributes.content: Oooh, I'm so scared! Hahahaha—
attributes.name: Thug at the Door B

attributes.content: I'd believe you if you said you managed to rustle up some borscht in this cesspit, but Originium-tipped bolts? Pull the other one. I've already taken the Originium out of every contraption in the area.
attributes.name: Thug at the Door B

attributes.content: Well, if you kids don't want to play nice, then don't blame us for what's next.
attributes.name: Thug at the Door A

attributes.content: Remember, keep them alive, otherwise we can't answer to the boss. You're up first, Pacient!
attributes.name: Thug at the Door A

attributes.content: It feels as if every swing of the axe is hacking at the students' minds. A crack opens up in the door, and a filthy, tattooed hand forces its way in, trying to unlatch the bolt.
(Quietly) Now.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Here's a one-way trip back to the hospital, Pacient!
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: He bellows as he lunges at the trespassing hand, stabbing it with his knife.
Argh! My hand! That punk actually stabbed me!
attributes.name: Thug at the Door B

attributes.content: Smash the door down! Skin those little bastards alive!
attributes.name: Thug at the Door A

attributes.content: The axe blows intensify, the wooden door now riddled with cracks. Snow-laden wind pours into the room as several tall shadows gather around the door, forming a wall of despair.
...Listen, Yeremey.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: If they catch us, they'll take us back and torture us... so don't hesitate, whether you have to do it to me, or to yourself.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Got it.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Nika, if we live through this, I—
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Save it for after we live through it! They're coming! Aim for the throat!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: The thugs grin wickedly as they pass through the doorframe, brandishing their steel pipes. Yeremey closes his eyes in desperation, readying his crude weapon for one last strike—
But the pain never comes. The Ursus who was oh-so arrogant earlier flies through the air like a burlap sack, slamming into the snow-covered ground outside. There is no further movement from him.
Who dares—ARGKH!
attributes.name: Thug at the Door B

attributes.content: I do. Got that?
The tall figure blocking the doorway does not even have time to turn his head before a hand bashes it against the frame.
Zima steps over his collapsed body, flicking the blood off her hands.
Y-You're...
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Hey hey, General Zima's here to save you.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Finally—
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: She cannot stop the tears from flowing, her tense shoulders collapsing from relief.
Don't worry, just take your time telling us what happened. We're here to help.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Were you with Leonid?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Leonid?
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: He's dead...
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Those bastards came up with something: an 'auction'.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Their boss Gromov cheated us. He said we'd be able to buy our freedom as long as we had enough money.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: But it was all a lie. It turned into a slaughterhouse.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Gromov had his people grade everyone like meatbeasts. The nobles with money were led to a building, and the commoners... I don't know what happened to them.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Thankfully, Yeremey was suspicious, and he didn't go straight in. We had to run for our lives to escape their pursuit.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: As for Leonid, he was full of confidence when he tried to 'discuss' things with Gromov...
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: He's buried here?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Da, behind the building.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Nika and I both saw it. One of the bastards dragged him over and was looting him for his clothes and watch.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: At the time, we thought we had managed to escape their base. Seeing that made me feel faint.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Nika grabbed a crowbar and gave that scumbag a surprise attack when he wasn't looking.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: We hid in his house, and we made it through the night, but we never expected his friends to show up at the door on the second day.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: I killed a man... but this was the only way we could avenge Leonid.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Something's off.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: We're still some distance away from the gang's base. They might come here on occasion to loot things, but they'd never actually live here, but you said this was one of their houses...
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: But he took a spade and some rations from this house. I thought—
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: No need to be so tense. Where did you bury him? I want to confirm his identity.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Why... are there corpses by the door?
...What did you people do to my house?
Your house, gospozha?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Where... Where's my husband? Have you seen him? He's just an ordinary worker, wearing a gray jacket. It's the last bit of warm clothing we have...
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: All the color drains out of Nika and Yeremey's faces in an instant. They give a subconscious glance towards the mound of dirt.
Y-You don't mean—
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: ...Dig him up.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The first thing to be unearthed is the deceased's patchwork gray jacket, followed by his cheeks, his head... and the dark red crack across his temple.
The woman crouches by her husband, her body shaking like a rusty machine as she strokes his face. It is the coldest thing she has touched in her entire life.
I-I didn't know, I really didn't.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: We thought he was with that Council of Sixteen because he was taking Leonid's clothes!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Council? Clothes?
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: Why can't we take things off the dead people Gromov kills?
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: We've been doing this for two whole months since they stopped all work here! What's wrong with making a living?! What do you know?!
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: You... You students, you murderers—
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: We're not—
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: We're very sorry, gospozha.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Forgive me, madam... Here, this watch is pure gold! And these silver coins... Take them! Please don't cry!
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: I'm so, so sorry! There's also these things we took from those thugs.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Without a word, Sonya pulled out her rations and essentials, placing them before the woman.
The other students were stunned for a moment, then silently began offering up whatever supplies they had managed to find.
...Ma'am. We were locked in here not long ago and had no idea what it was really like. Those atrocities... everyone has been on edge.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: But regardless... we made mistakes, and we will take responsibility for them.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: We will accept whatever punishment you deem fit.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Please, take this as a token of our regret... Our camp is just nearby. We will do everything we can to help you and your child get through this.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I am truly sorry. I was the one who acted. It had nothing to do with Yeremey, Sonya, or the others. If you must punish someone, punish—
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: The woman lifts her head. There is no desire in her eyes, merely an empty hate.
She grabs the coins and the watch, throwing them at Nika's face.
GET OUT!
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: Take your blood money with you! You think you can buy Ivan's life with these pieces of metal? You think it will bring back the father of my children?!
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: You can do anything, can't you? You dare to kill, yes? Then why didn't you dare to kill the man who did all of this? You can all go to hell!
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: If we weren't forced to live like this... Why would my husband become a robber and rob the dead of their clothes? Why would we have to become such wretched things...?
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: Alright then.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: If it'll bring you some peace or closure, we'll do it.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Both for you, and for our friends... I swear to you, Gromov, who caused all of this, will die this winter.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Please, take care of yourself... When we smash open the gate to the quarantine zone, we will all get out of here together.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: If that's the case...
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Have Nika and Yeremey show you the way, Sonya. I'll head back and get help from Antosha.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Sure.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Everyone else, with me. This is our new mission.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: She pulls up Nika, slumped against the ground. She leads the students into the snowstorm, where they fade from sight.
(Sobs)...
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: Wh-Why are you still here? To laugh at me?!
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: Not long after I was born, my mother had to bury my father on her own. He was killed by bandits.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: You—
attributes.name: Haggard Worker

attributes.content: Your husband was no criminal, and he never hurt anyone. He fought for you and your children, until the very end.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Don't let his sacrifice be in vain. Take everything he fought so hard for... and live.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: He takes the gold watch she threw away, forcing it into the icy palm of her hand, and folds her fingers around it.
